blood_sampling_recommendations.recommendation: Measure cardiac troponins with high-sensitivity assays immediately after presentation and obtain the results within 60 min of blood sampling.
blood_sampling_recommendations.notes: Timely hs-cTn measurement; citation refs shown on page.

blood_sampling_recommendations.recommendation: Use an ESC algorithmic approach with serial high-sensitivity cardiac troponin (hs-cTn) measurements (0 h/1 h or 0 h/2 h) to rule in and rule out NSTEMI.
blood_sampling_recommendations.notes: Serial measurements at specified intervals per ESC algorithm.

blood_sampling_recommendations.recommendation: Additional testing after 3 h is recommended if the first two hs-cTn measurements of the 0 h/1 h algorithm are inconclusive and no alternative diagnoses explaining the condition have been made.
blood_sampling_recommendations.notes: Perform further testing at 3 h when initial 0 h/1 h results are inconclusive.

blood_sampling_recommendations.recommendation: Consider use of established risk scores (e.g., GRACE risk score) for prognosis estimation.
blood_sampling_recommendations.notes: Risk stratification recommended to aid prognosis estimation.

triage_for_emergency_reperfusion_strateg.recommendation: Patients with suspected STEMI should be immediately triaged for an emergency reperfusion strategy.
triage_for_emergency_reperfusion_strateg.notes: Immediate triage for reperfusion in suspected ST-elevation myocardial infarction.

abbreviations_from_page.GRACE: Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events (risk score)
